newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka said soon to close DM300-700 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka said soon to close DM300-700 mln loan.

text.p: Croatia's leading commercial bank Zagrebacka Banka is about to close a deal raising between 300 and 700 million German marks in syndicated funds from foreign creditors, a banking source said on Thursday.
The exact amount and terms of the loan will be announced when the transaction is completed, the source told Reuters.
"It is quite likely the amount will be larger (than Zagrebacka's original target)," he added.
The bank said in a press release it had sought to tap the international loan market for 300 million marks in three-year funds.
This was to substitute its planned borrowing through a Eurobond issue, now abandoned, after it secured long- and short-term investment grade ratings from two leading agencies.
More than 50 "most prestigious international banks" had joined a syndicate offering it 700 million marks, it said.
One American, one British, a German and a Japanese bank arranged the loan, with 11 banks acting as co-arrangers.
The bank did not mention the interest it will have to pay or the purpose of the loan. The loan agreement is expected to be signed by mid-June. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
